proportion_source.reference_note: The six-view sheet is an uncalibrated visual-match sheet of the same blue Lanju aerosol can. It provides the front/back/side label artwork, the blue over-cap topology and the stamped metal base. It is not a calibrated turntable and no panel is treated as measured geometry.
proportion_source.visible_structure: One upright blue aerosol can: cylindrical printed body with a narrow bright metal base ring, blue plastic over-cap with a large U-shaped spray well, raised circular nozzle boss, small ribbed actuator with a real front orifice, and a concave stamped metal bottom (20240315 / A3247B).
proportion_source.pixel_ratios: Front six-view silhouette is about 120 px wide and 447 px high (width/height about 0.268). The cap/body seam is at about 21% of the height from the top and the visible metal base band is about 1.5% of the height. The candidate uses diameter/height about 0.269, not a measured dimension.

layout.note: Single can upright. The source photo is a three-quarter view from +X; the candidate front label is placed at +X and the texture seam (printed label wrap join) at -X.

body.note: Closed metal body under the label sleeve. The top is hidden by the over-cap and is not claimed as visible geometry.

label.note: Closed thin printed label sleeve. Its artwork is inverse-projected from the four six-view side panels; the wrap seam is at -X.

bottom.note: Concave aluminium base cup with rolled outer rim, a step ring and an inner ridge. The stamped code is reproduced as a texture from the readable bottom panel; engraving depth is inferred.

cavity.note: Boolean cavity leaves a hollow skirt with a bottom opening around the can body; the top remains solid above the well floor.

well.note: U-shaped spray pocket cut into the cap top, with a deep back floor and a lower front lip so the recess is visible from the front. Depth and wall contours follow the top/front panels approximately.

actuator.note: Small dark-blue ribbed actuator on the boss. A real cylindrical bore passes through its front wall into a dark cavity; the spray direction is +X.

nozzle_insert.note: Dark insert behind the real bore, forming a visible dark cavity rather than a painted dot.

cap.note: Blue plastic over-cap rebuilt from the reference top/front/side panels, with a hollow skirt, U-shaped well and separate actuator. Internal valve, spring and dip tube are not modelled.

label.note: Printed gloss label on a metal can; the visible surface is dielectric print. Metallic body underneath is a separate hidden part.

cap.note: Glossy blue moulded plastic with light use scratches sampled from the rust photograph.

metal.note: Bright brushed aluminium base/rim; metal reflection is applicable.

bottom.note: Concave stamped aluminium base. The code is a stamped texture, not a printed label; metallic response is applicable.

reference_crop.note: Label band rows shared by the four side panels of this registered six-view sheet; caps above and the metal base below are excluded from the wrap.
